examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The plain editor inside a `Field`: line numbers, two-space Tab indentation (Escape then Tab leaves), and server diagnostics as `markers` painted on their lines and listed under the editor. Pass a `loader` that wires Monaco's workers and returns `import('monaco-editor')` (the Monaco example) and Monaco takes over the same value and markers once it loads.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CodeEditor from '@aziontech/webkit/code-editor'
  import Field from '@aziontech/webkit/field'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const code = ref(`export default async function handler(request) {
  const url = new URL(request.url)
  const name = url.searchParams.get('name')
  return new Response(\`Hello, \${name}\`)
}
`)

  const markers = [
    { line: 3, severity: 'warning', message: 'name can be null; give it a default value.' },
    { line: 4, severity: 'info', message: 'Set a Content-Type header on the response.' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <Field>
    <Field.Label>Function code</Field.Label>
    <CodeEditor
      v-model="code"
      language="javascript"
      :markers="markers"
      height="14rem"
    />
    <Field.Description>Runs on every request that reaches this function.</Field.Description>
  </Field>
</template>

examples.name: Monaco
examples.summary: The real Monaco, loaded lazily: `loadMonaco` wires the editor, JSON and TypeScript workers with Vite's `?worker` imports on the monaco-editor 0.56+ paths (`monaco-editor/editor/editor.worker`, `monaco-editor/languages/features/<language>/<language>.worker`; the old `monaco-editor/esm/vs/...` paths no longer resolve), sets `MonacoEnvironment`, then returns `import('monaco-editor')`. `monaco-editor` is the app's dependency (an optional peer of WebKit), so it never enters WebKit's bundle. The editor and the diff take the theme tokens and the markers; the function editor zero-pads its line numbers with `padLineNumbers` and colours function calls; the plain editor is live until Monaco mounts.

examples.name: WithToolbar
examples.summary: The function editor of the console: the `toolbar` slot holds a Code / Arguments switch, a hint and a Run action, `padLineNumbers` zero-pads the gutter (01, 02…), and the markers follow the active document.
